English: {stops} AT stops. Timetable end date not specified.
Draft te reo Māori: E {stops} ngā tūnga AT. Kāore te rā mutunga o te wātaka i tohua.
Kua rokirokia ki tēnei pūrere.

English: Storage was unavailable; an internet connection will be needed on your next visit.
Draft te reo Māori: Kāore i wātea te rokiroki; me whai hononga ipurangi i tō hokinga mai.

English: Scheduled routing runs entirely in your browser.
Draft te reo Māori: Ka whakahaeretia katoatia te rapu ara ā-wātaka i tō pūtirotiro.

English: Downloading the latest timetable available on this server…
Draft te reo Māori: Kei te tikiake i te wātaka hou e wātea ana i tēnei tūmau…
Kei te tirotiro i ngā whakahoutanga ratonga…
Kāore he whakatūpato i whakahokia mai e AT.

English: Service updates need an internet connection. Your downloaded timetable is still available.
Draft te reo Māori: Me whai hononga ipurangi mō ngā whakahoutanga ratonga. Kei te wātea tonu tō wātaka kua tikiakehia.

English: You can view current announcements on the AT website when online.
Draft te reo Māori: Ka taea te tiro i ngā pānui o nāianei i te pae tukutuku a AT ina hono ki te ipurangi.

English: No active app version was found.
Draft te reo Māori: Kāore i kitea he putanga taupānga hohe.

English: The active app did not confirm its version. Keep this page open and try again.
Draft te reo Māori: Kāore te taupānga hohe i whakaū i tōna putanga. Waiho tēnei whārangi kia tuwhera, ka whakamātau anō.

English: The new version could not be installed. Your existing app is still available.
Draft te reo Māori: Kāore i taea te tāuta i te putanga hou. Kei te wātea tonu tō taupānga o nāianei.

English: The update is taking longer than expected. Try again while online.
Draft te reo Māori: Kei te roa ake te whakahoutanga i tā te whakaaro. Whakamātau anō ina hono ki te ipurangi.

English: Could not activate the update. Please try again.
Draft te reo Māori: Kāore i taea te whakahohe i te whakahoutanga. Whakamātau anō.

English: This update was replaced. Please try again.
Draft te reo Māori: Kua whakakapihia tēnei whakahoutanga. Whakamātau anō.

English: An app update is ready. Choose Update and reopen.
Draft te reo Māori: Kua rite he whakahoutanga taupānga. Kōwhiria te Whakahou, ka huaki anō.

English: Your app is up to date.
Draft te reo Māori: Kei te putanga hou tō taupānga.

English: Checking and downloading the latest interface…
Draft te reo Māori: Kei te tirotiro me te tikiake i te atanga hou…

Draft te reo Māori: Huakina tēnei whārangi mā te wāhitau HTTPS kotahi o tō taupānga Along kua tāutahia.
